taxonomies.name: Tool Shape
taxonomies.definition: The physical form and straightness of craft tools and implements, e.g. warped pencils, curved markers, bent tools

taxonomies.name: Tip Durability
taxonomies.definition: The strength and longevity of pointed ends on craft tools like markers or pencils, e.g. strong tips, break-resistant points, durable ends

taxonomies.name: Container Size
taxonomies.definition: The physical dimensions and capacity of product containers or packaging units, e.g. small containers, mini-sized jars, compact storage boxes

taxonomies.name: Surface Texture
taxonomies.definition: The tactile feel and consistency of craft material surfaces, e.g. smooth application, even texture, consistent feel

taxonomies.name: Package Condition
taxonomies.definition: The physical state and integrity of packaging upon delivery or purchase, e.g. damaged boxes, opened containers, torn wrapping

taxonomies.name: Color Selection
taxonomies.definition: The range and variety of different colors offered in a product set, e.g. multiple color options, diverse palette choices, assorted hues

taxonomies.name: Product Quantity
taxonomies.definition: The amount or volume of craft material provided in each package or unit, e.g. one ounce portions, handful amounts, bulk quantities

taxonomies.name: Grip Comfort
taxonomies.definition: The ease and comfort of holding and manipulating craft tools and materials, e.g. easy grip surfaces, comfortable handling, ergonomic design

taxonomies.name: Package Design
taxonomies.definition: The visual appeal and structural features of product packaging, e.g. attractive box designs, cute containers, flip-top functionality

taxonomies.name: Material Quality
taxonomies.definition: The overall construction and composition quality of craft materials, e.g. premium ingredients, durable formulations, quality manufacturing

taxonomies.name: Tip Performance
taxonomies.definition: The functional quality and consistency of pointed tool tips during use, e.g. smooth writing, even flow, consistent application

taxonomies.name: Color Quality
taxonomies.definition: The visual appeal and intensity of colors in craft materials, e.g. vibrant shades, bright appearance, bold pigmentation

taxonomies.name: Material Safety
taxonomies.definition: The safety characteristics and composition of craft materials for child use, e.g. non-toxic formulations, wheat-free ingredients, safe compounds

taxonomies.name: Tip Wear Resistance
taxonomies.definition: How well drawing or writing implements maintain their functional tip or edge during use, e.g. markers retain fine points after extensive drawing, chalk doesn't wear down too quickly

taxonomies.name: Product Longevity
taxonomies.definition: The overall lifespan and durability of the art supply under normal usage conditions, e.g. crayons last through multiple projects, paint tubes provide consistent output over months

taxonomies.name: Color Vibrancy Performance
taxonomies.definition: The visual quality and intensity of colors produced by the art supply, e.g. markers produce bold saturated lines, watercolors show rich pigmentation

taxonomies.name: Moisture Control
taxonomies.definition: How well the product maintains optimal moisture levels during use, preventing premature drying or excessive wetness, e.g. paint stays workable for extended periods, markers don't dry out when caps are left off

taxonomies.name: Product Restoration
taxonomies.definition: The ability to revive or refresh the art supply when it begins to lose effectiveness, e.g. dried paint can be reactivated with water, hardened clay becomes pliable with moisture

taxonomies.name: Physical Durability
taxonomies.definition: The physical robustness of the product during handling and maintenance activities, e.g. pencil leads don't snap during sharpening, brush handles don't crack with regular use

taxonomies.name: Maintenance Response
taxonomies.definition: How well the product responds to sharpening, cleaning, or other upkeep procedures, e.g. colored pencils achieve fine points when sharpened, brushes maintain their shape after washing

taxonomies.name: Application Smoothness
taxonomies.definition: The smoothness and ease of applying the medium to paper or canvas, e.g. crayons glide without scratching, paint flows evenly without streaking

taxonomies.name: Color Blending Capability
taxonomies.definition: The ability of the medium to mix and transition smoothly with other colors or layers, e.g. pastels create seamless gradients, colored pencils layer without waxy buildup
